_doc: D-S4 parity fixture, single-pass float centrality lane. Asserted by graph-centrality-parity.spec.ts (browser) AND GraphCentralityParityTest (inspecto-la-graph). The expected values are DERIVED BY HAND, not produced by either implementation (betweenness by pair-counting the shortest paths; closeness as (reach/(N-1))*(reach/sum of distances) with N=10; Jaccard as |A∩B|/|A∪B|; Adamic-Adar as sums of 1/ln(degree) of the shared neighbours, ln constants taken from Python's math.log). Floats are compared at 1e-9. Labels are lowercase ASCII on purpose: ties break by label, and the browser uses localeCompare while Java uses ordinal compare, which agree only on such labels. Every edge endpoint is a node. e7 duplicates e1 (a parallel edge: betweenness' sigma doubles but the result must not change; the simple-graph algorithms collapse it), e8 is a self-loop on f (ignored by every algorithm here), g-h-j is a disconnected triangle (adjacent pairs that share a neighbour: link prediction must skip them), i is isolated. Simple undirected shape: a-b, b-c, b-d, c-e, d-e, e-f (a diamond b,c,d,e with a tail a and a tail f).
